about: W2b placement fixture (G-P1, G-LIVE-B): gold importance (scored within +-2) and stability (exact). Items are reviewed 4 per job/call, in file order.

items.title: Never run pytest on the dev database
items.text: Running pytest without HLM_TEST_DSN truncated the dev database and lost the imported corpus. Always point tests at a dedicated database.

items.title: Coffee machine
items.text: The office coffee machine was broken this morning.

items.title: Current sprint focus
items.text: This week we are working on the librarian placement prompt; the contradiction batching is next.

items.title: Secrets never in git
items.text: API keys and tokens must never be committed; gitleaks runs in the pre-commit hook and in CI.

items.title: Architecture: one MCP server
items.text: HLMemo is exposed as a single remote MCP server over streamable HTTP; all three CLIs talk to it.

items.title: License badge
items.text: The README shows a license badge.

items.title: How to add a device
items.text: To add a device: run hlm_ops.sh device mint with a grant, pipe the token into hlm device login --token-stdin, then register the CLIs with hlm mcp add.

items.title: Temporary workaround
items.text: Until the upstream fix lands, the worker is restarted by hand every morning.

items.title: Destructive restore
items.text: restore.sh drops and recreates the database; always take a fresh dump right before running it.

items.title: Editor preference
items.text: The owner prefers dark mode in the terminal.

items.title: Open question for tomorrow
items.text: Tomorrow: ask the owner whether the batch size should be 25 or 50.

items.title: Production host
items.text: Production runs on a Hostinger KVM 2 VPS in Vilnius with 2 vCPU and 8 GiB of RAM.

items.title: Docker ports bypass ufw
items.text: Ports published by Docker bypass ufw rules; only the provider firewall protects them.

items.title: Test run
items.text: Ran the unit tests once more; all green.

items.title: Default query budget
items.text: Callers usually pass token_budget 2000 to memory.query.

items.title: Build in progress
items.text: The Docker image for release R2 is still building.

items.title: Veritabanı şifreleri
items.text: Veritabanı şifrelerini asla komut satırı argümanı olarak verme; ps çıktısında görünür.

items.title: Bugünkü toplantı
items.text: Bugün saat 15:00'te kısa bir durum toplantısı var.

items.title: Proje dili
items.text: Kod ve dokümantasyon İngilizce, sahip ile yazışmalar Türkçe.

items.title: Sürüm yayınlama adımları
items.text: Sürüm yayınlamak için: yerel kapıları çalıştır, deploy.sh ile gönder, remote_gates.sh ile doğrula, bir gün sonra --accept-release çalıştır.

items.title: Geçici hata
items.text: OpenRouter şu an zaman zaman 503 döndürüyor.

items.title: Üretim verisini silme
items.text: Üretim veritabanında TRUNCATE veya DROP komutlarını asla elle çalıştırma; veri kaybı geri alınamaz.

items.title: Entscheidung: Postgres statt Graphiti
items.text: Wir bauen die bitemporale Schicht auf eigenem PostgreSQL-Schema statt auf Graphiti.

items.title: Wetter
items.text: Heute regnet es in Berlin.

items.title: Aktueller Stand
items.text: Die Import-Pipeline ist zu etwa 60 Prozent fertig.

items.title: Heredoc und ssh
items.text: In Schleifen immer ssh -n verwenden, sonst liest ssh den stdin der Schleife leer und das Deploy-Skript bricht still ab.

items.title: Rollback durchführen
items.text: Rollback: deploy.sh --rollback nur zwischen W0+-Releases; sonst vorwärts reparieren und den letzten Dump wiederherstellen.

items.title: Namenskonvention Branches
items.text: Feature-Branches heißen feat/<thema>.

items.title: Embedding model pinned
items.text: Embeddings use intfloat/multilingual-e5-small pinned to revision 614241f6.

items.title: Production outage
items.text: Production was down for 40 minutes after a migration locked the events table; writes failed during that time.

items.title: Nice to know
items.text: The project name HLMemo stands for Human-Like Memory.

items.title: Waiting for review
items.text: The W2b branch is waiting for the Sol review.

items.title: Lease renewal
items.text: Long librarian jobs lost their lease and ran twice until the lease was renewed every 30 seconds.

items.title: Admin token handling
items.text: The admin bearer token grants full access; it is never bound in production and lives only in the ops environment.

items.title: Lunch break
items.text: The team is on a lunch break right now.

items.title: Git remote
items.text: The repository is published on GitHub under the NeverGET account.

items.title: Draft plan for next week
items.text: Next week we might try gemini embeddings if time allows.

items.title: Recording cassettes
items.text: To record cassettes: run the test with HLM_LLM_MODE=record and the key file, then commit the new jsonl lines; replay is strict.

items.title: Unpinned model download
items.text: An unpinned model download silently changed our embeddings; pin every model by revision.

items.title: Temporary feature flag
items.text: The synthesis flag is turned off for this week's testing.

items.title: Owner identity
items.text: The owner of all projects is Cemal; decisions need his approval.

items.title: Log line format
items.text: Tool calls log one INFO line with tool, device, client, outcome and milliseconds.

items.title: Never force-push main
items.text: Force-pushing main destroyed a colleague's commits once; never force-push shared branches.

items.title: Deploy of R1
items.text: Release R1 was deployed to production on 2026-09-23 and all remote gates passed.

items.title: Disk usage today
items.text: The production disk is 23 percent full today.

items.title: Data retention law
items.text: Personal data of Turkish users falls under KVKK; the work computer must not sync it to this server.

items.title: Kod stili
items.text: Satır uzunluğu en fazla 110 karakter; ruff format zorunlu.

items.title: Kahve molası
items.text: Şu anda kahve molasındayım.

items.title: Devam eden iş
items.text: Şu anda G-L3 kapısı yeniden çalıştırılıyor; sonuç bir saat içinde gelecek.

items.title: Lock timeout
items.text: Canlı veritabanında indeks değiştirirken kısa bir lock_timeout kullan; yoksa tüm yazmalar kuyrukta bekler ve servis durur.

items.title: Architekturprinzip
items.text: Modell, Embedding, Datenbank und Hosting sind Konfiguration, nie Code (Provider-agnostisch).

items.title: Meeting verschoben
items.text: Das Status-Meeting wurde auf morgen verschoben.

items.title: Heutige Aufgabe
items.text: Heute wird die Fixture für die Platzierung geschrieben.

items.title: Token nie in argv
items.text: Token nie als Kommandozeilenargument übergeben: sie landen in der Shell-History und in ps; immer über stdin.

items.title: Response format
items.text: Every tool result is one JSON text block with a budget block.

items.title: Pending dependency bump
items.text: psycopg 3.3 is out; we have not upgraded yet.

items.title: Debugging a slow query
items.text: For a slow memory.query: check the GIN pending list, run EXPLAIN on the candidate SQL with prepare=False, and compare generic versus custom plans.

items.title: Mascot
items.text: The team jokingly calls the librarian 'Libby'.

items.title: Backups untested
items.text: A backup that was never restored is not a backup: an untested dump was corrupt when we needed it.

items.title: Current load test result
items.text: Today's load test measured p95 251 ms; it will be re-run after the next change.

items.title: Time zone
items.text: All timestamps are stored in UTC.

items.text: A rename of one test helper function is in progress.

items.title: Security boundary
items.text: The librarian never acts with all grants: every job carries the triggering device's capability set, rechecked at apply.

items.text: We are waiting for the owner to top up the OpenRouter wallet.
